Upcoming

2026 calendar
14–18 October 2026
London · Regent's Park

Frieze London 2026

A solo presentation by Solveig Tarkamp, extending the research of Halbinsel / Peninsula into a new body of small-scale basalt works produced specifically for the fair. The booth includes a single new Notation drawing.

Booth E07 · Main Section
Viewing room →
19–22 November 2026
Cologne · Koelnmesse Hallen 11.2 & 11.3

Art Cologne 2026

A two-artist presentation pairing new paintings by Inés Berruga with three small bronzes from Hannes Reiter's ongoing Vorläufig series. Berruga's Mariposas, después opens in Berlin the same week.

Booth A21 · Galleries 2026
Viewing room →
3–6 December 2026
Miami Beach · Miami Beach Convention Center

Art Basel Miami Beach 2026

Beton Galerie returns to ABMB with a group presentation: new works by Ade Okonkwo, Yui Maekawa, Amaal Hersi, and Margit Eilers. The booth opens to first-choice collectors on 2 December.

Booth N18 · Nova
Viewing room →
15–21 June 2026
Basel · Messeplatz, Hall 1.1

Liste Art Fair Basel 2026

A focused presentation of Amaal Hersi's newest textile sculptures, made in response to the artist's recent fieldwork in Hargeisa. Marks Hersi's first appearance at a major international fair under the gallery.

Booth 31 · Floor 1
Viewing room →

Trade information

Sales, consignments & viewing rooms

For all sales inquiries during fairs, please contact Karim Behzadi, Senior Curator, at sales@betongalerie.de. Press and image requests should be directed to press@betongalerie.de. Collectors may request booth previews ahead of each fair via the gallery's mailing list.

Beton Galerie

Auguststraße 47, 10117 Berlin-Mitte. Founded 2011 by Anneliese Vogel and Karim Behzadi. Representing twelve international artists working in sculpture, installation, video, painting, and performance.
